verdict.rationale: Rev AI's marketing site claims the product can be deployed on-prem, which is a first-party statement of self-hosting the core speech-to-text product. It is only a single thin marketing line, with no docs on how to deploy, license, or run it. Missing for 10: on-prem deployment documentation, supported runtimes or containers, hardware requirements, licensing or availability terms, feature parity details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Deploy in the cloud or on-prem.
